svg.aria-label: A Jev request: one state, a support ticket about a failing Stripe integration, is read once and shared by three questions, a Choice, a Score and a Noul. Each question sees the state and its own text only, never the other questions, and returns its own typed answer: technical at 0.79, a frustration score of 1.01, and 1.00 for urgency.
